notes.title: Save Files after Update
notes.content:
The recent update on 6/10/24 caused files to be saved and loaded from a different folder (Alpha_and_Iota_Version_6 instead of Alpha_and_Iota_Version_5 within local app data). If you had save and option files from the previous build, they should still exist, but will need to be manually moved to the new folder.

To recover your progress, you can simply replace the save and options files in the folder Alpha_and_Iota_Version_6 with your existing save and options files from Alpha_and_Iota_Version_5.

These folders should be in C:\Users\[username]\AppData\Local

As a shortcut, you can just type %localappdata% into the search bar. This should take you right to where the relevant folders are.

Apologies for the inconvenience. For future updates I will make sure that save data is transferred over automatically.

Thank you for playtesting, and please do join the discord channel if you'd like to share your thoughts, report a bug, or discuss the game: [url=https://discord.gg/GfK39CSBWF]https://discord.gg/GfK39CSBWF[/url]

notes.title: Welcome to the Alpha and Iota playtest!
notes.content:
Welcome, and thank you for playtesting! After working on Alpha and Iota in my spare time for years, I am so excited to finally start sharing it with others. Here are a few things to get you started:

[list]
[*] The best place to report on your playtesting experience (and engage with the community) is the official Alpha and Iota discord channel, which you can join with the following link: [url=https://discord.gg/XeMgCNHPjZ]https://discord.gg/XeMgCNHPjZ[/url]
If you would prefer not to use discord, you are also welcome to create discussion posts here on the Steam community page.
[*] Alpha and Iota is still very much a work in progress. In addition to bug reports, I welcome suggestions for changes and new features. Candid, specific feedback on what you enjoyed and what you didn't is greatly appreciated.
[*] If you get stuck on a challenging puzzle, please feel free to use the in-game assist features! You are also more than welcome to ask for help on discord. I (or perhaps another playtester) would be happy to assist you.
[*] If you enjoy the game, please do share it with friends! As a first time solo developer without much of a marketing budget, I'm going to be relying in large part on word-of-mouth to reach new players.

[/list]
